baseline.real_scenario: Pressure-test skill-refiner on github-repo-radar to prove external best-practice research depth before any production Skill change.
baseline.business_constraint: Shadow run only: no shared/skills/github-repo-radar production file modification.
baseline.success_standard: Every SR-R ring records official, GitHub, and community source classes; result and ledger validate; run-all lists the dedicated gate.
baseline.known_pain: Earlier co-creation could stay shallow or only research Flow, leaving other rings supported by local context only.
baseline.non_loss_capability: Keep github-repo-radar seven-layer evaluation, red lines, action states, and no-single-signal verdicts.
baseline.entry_point: Eval and Resource, because the missing behavior is a verifiable source-depth contract and source audit artifact.
baseline.open_questions: No production modification decision is made in this shadow run; SR-F1 freezes only the shadow evidence package.

professional_domain.name: GitHub repository discovery and evaluation
responsibilities: Discover GitHub repositories with current GitHub or authoritative upstream evidence
Evaluate purpose fit, license, maintenance, security, adoption, contribution path, and exit path
Convert evidence into action states: discard, watch, trial, deep-read, contribute, or adopt
non_goals: Use stars, Trending, README, downloads, or Scorecard totals as single-point verdicts
Modify github-repo-radar production Skill during this shadow run
Recommend repositories without live or authoritative evidence
professional_domain.success_boundary: A refinement run can prove all-ring external source depth without changing the target Skill.
